verbatim: The current Opus 4.8 based-monitor has higher recall against the strong strategies known about from red-teaming the Opus 4.6 monitor.
reasoning: Verified independently and improved on one point the previous pass could not settle. Anthropic's Redacted Risk Report August 2026 — a primary document published under the RSP, roughly three months after the finding — adopts SLEIGHT-Bench by name into its standing monitor-assurance suite and reports its deployed monitors against it in Table 2.23.1.2.B.
